pages.quiz:
CORE MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/4
   D. 1/2

2. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

3. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 23.6
   C. 29
   D. 23

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 5
   C. 7
   D. 1

5. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 21
   C. 15.6
   D. 15.7

6. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 16
   C. 5
   D. 4

7. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 18
   C. 9
   D. 81

8. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 40

9. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27.6
   C. 27
   D. 27.7

10. Solve for x: x + 3 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 3
   C. 11
   D. 13

11. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 37
   C. 2
   D. 1

12. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

13. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 122
   C. 11
   D. 22

14. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 49
   C. 7
   D. 50

15. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

16. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x = 5
   B. x > 5
   C. x < 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

17. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 77
   C. 18
   D. 36

18. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 1

19. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19
   C. 19.6
   D. 19.7

20. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 10
   C. 25
   D. 5

21. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 12x

22. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 24
   C. 48
   D. 156

23. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 21
   C. 9
   D. 20

24. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 90
   C. 18
   D. 36

25. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 37
   C. 31
   D. 31.6

26. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 12
   C. 33
   D. 4

27. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 7

   C. 13
   D. 1

28. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 48

   D. 49

29. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 29
   C. 11
   D. 28

30. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 43
   D. 1
